info.name: Lab 11 — QA Shop Performance API Checks
info.description: Postman collection for API functional checks before or after the JMeter load test. Local QA Shop catalogue and case-insensitive search endpoints.

exec: pm.test('Response is JSON array with 3 products', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(3); });
pm.test('Each product has id, name, and price', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (product) { pm.expect(product).to.have.all.keys('id', 'name', 'price'); }); });

item.name: Search is case-insensitive and finds keyboard

exec: pm.test('Search finds product id 1', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body[0].id).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Search matches keyboard regardless of case', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].name.toLowerCase()).to.include('keyboard'); });
